children: A Repulsor Pad is used mostly to ease manual labor. In essence, it is a flat board with four repulsors, one at each corner, that can be used to lift heavy objects for short-range transport. This allows a single worker to move a heavy crate or other object without the need to use a
or a Binary Load Lifter. During

Each Repulsor Pad occupies a single square and can be used to lift an object that occupies no more space than a single square; multiple Repulsor Pads can be used to lift larger objects. Activating a Repulsor Pad (or a group of Repulsor Pads) is a
, and a Repulsor Pad can move along with a character if that character uses a
to grab or drag the Repulsor Pad. If two creatures attempt to pull a Repulsor Pad in opposite directions, they make opposed
checks, and the Repulsor Pad moves along with the victor.
